vision.name: Overpowering Attack
vision.text:
[Attack] Energy attack costing 2 stages. DAMAGE: 5 life cards. Search your Life Deck or discard pile for an Ally and place it into play at 5 stages above 0.
(Limit 1 per deck.)
vision.note: grey frame. '(Limit 1 per deck.)' sits on its own line at the END of the text box, unlike every other Set 1 card where limits lead the text; with the (Errata) filename flag this image looks edited to show errata. Check against the CRD in Phase 3.
